name: Pony
author: Tyler Kamstra
version: v2 authored player traits, read in a text mirror
heading: Pony Traits
sourceDistinctions: The three horse entries explicitly point to Pony. Their encounter versions and art remain distinct.
The Outlander background’s musical instrument and any other hand-operated gear are unavailable under No Hands.

name: Quipper
author: Tyler Kamstra
version: v2 authored player traits, read in a text mirror
heading: Quipper Traits
sourceDistinctions: This is the individual Quipper. Swarm of Quippers has no role in this build.
The supplement’s Tiny equipment rules apply to equipment and carrying capacity. The printed natural bite keeps its listed damage and Finesse treatment.

name: Reef Shark
author: Tyler Kamstra
version: v2 authored player traits, read in a text mirror
heading: Reef Shark Traits
sourceDistinctions: This printing grants +1 Strength, 30-ft. blindsight and Pack Tactics as a bonus action. It grants no natural armor. The separate Hunter Shark and Giant Shark publication scope is outside this profile.

name: Rhinoceros
author: Tyler Kamstra
version: v2 authored player traits, read in a text mirror
heading: Rhinoceros Traits
sourceDistinctions: Player Rhinoceros is Medium. This charge uses the core contested shove instead of a monster save DC.
The 1st-level monk’s bonus kick uses the Martial Arts die and bludgeoning damage under Monstrous Races v2 p. 7. Natural Armor changes the AC calculation but does not count as worn armor.

name: Scorpion
author: Tyler Kamstra
version: v2 authored player traits, read in a text mirror
heading: Scorpion Traits
sourceDistinctions: The Giant Scorpion has separate player rules. The ordinary Scorpion gives no darkvision or monster-sting save.
Use the Tiny carrying capacity rule. The natural sting keeps its printed damage and Finesse treatment.
